id: title:dmarchuk:drop the urgency prefix from sending suspension emails

review.posthog_relevance: Account management and support operations: this hunk changes the subject line of an email sent by the `send_email_sending_suspended` task, which notifies account owners of suspension. The removal of the '[Action required]' prefix is a deliverability improvement.
review.reason: This hunk P1.F1.H1 changes the subject line of an email sent by the `send_email_sending_suspended` task. The removal of the '[Action required]' prefix is accompanied by a comment explaining that this prefix caused emails to be filtered to junk folders in production. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and behavior correction.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the comment's claim about production filtering, which is not independently verified by test results or broader implementation context. No score can account for unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H2 is not supplied in the input chunk, so it cannot be reviewed. P1.F1.H1 is supplied and reviewed below.

observations.behavior: The subject line of the email sent by the `send_email_sending_suspended` task is changed. The removal of the '[Action required]' prefix is accompanied by a comment explaining that this prefix caused emails to be filtered to junk folders in production.
observations.code_quote: subject=f"Email sending has been suspended for project '{team}'",
observations.posthog_connection: This change targets email deliverability for PostHog's account management. By removing the urgency marker, the email is more likely to reach the account owner, allowing them to address the suspension. This could prevent account lockouts or support ticket escalation due to missed warnings.
